name: Memento
author: Mahesh
summary: Uses SuperMemory to save and retrieve context shared across your work, personal, and coding assistants.
starterPrompt: Explain how you use SuperMemory, then help me choose which context to save. Show what would be stored before adding anything.
usageNote: Requires a SuperMemory connection. Review the service's data handling and avoid saving passwords, credentials, or sensitive personal details.
